To send people to the Moon, engineers have to decide what's fire-safe up there.
NASA's fire experiments hold the answers. But they're scattered, and none in its archive ran in lunar gravity.
So we built the dashboard. Ask about a cabin, and it ranks NASA's evidence, explains it, and flags what's untested.
Then we went beyond it. In a real fire, that call is live. So in our simulated lunar cabin, an AI crew member uses the same evidence to decide, and act.
